FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Fit Ninja different from typical gym loggers? ▾
Fit Ninja is not a passive notebook. It features 1,324+ animated looping video demos, tactile set steppers with smart rest timers, automated progressive overload (+2.5 kg auto bump), anatomical fatigue heatmaps, and adaptive macro nutrition tailored for fat loss and lean muscle retention.
Does Fit Ninja work completely offline? ▾
Yes. Fit Ninja is built with offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) architecture. Your workouts, rest timers, and exercise guides work seamlessly without any cell reception or Wi-Fi in basement gyms.
Can I cancel my subscription anytime? ▾
Yes. You can cancel your subscription with a single tap in Settings at any time. There are no lock-in contracts or hidden cancellation fees.
